## Who Are [We]{.accent}? {background-color="#252525"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}

::: {.hook}
We build technology that understands [you]{.accent}.
:::

Not just your commands —
your **attention**, your **stress**, even your **mistakes** *before they happen*.

::: {.punchline}
[Brain]{.accent} · [AI]{.accent} · [Robotics]{.accent} — working together.
:::

## What If a Robot Could Read Your [Mind]{.accent}? {background-color="#252525"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.hook}
A headset — but instead of music, it reads your [brainwaves]{.accent}.
:::

- *Stressed?* → Robot **slows down**.
- *Overwhelmed?* → Robot **takes over**.
- *Zoning out?* → Robot **asks for attention**.

::: {.punchline}
The robot adapts to [you]{.accent}. Not the other way around.
:::

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](../../images/work/377A0907.jpg)
:::
:::

---

## What Do Your Eyes [Reveal]{.accent}? {background-color="#252525"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.hook}
In [200 milliseconds]{.accent}, your eyes reveal exactly what you're thinking.
:::

Experts see *differently* — a **surgeon's gaze**, a **pilot's scan**, a **drone operator's** focus.

We recorded those eye movements and trained AI to *copy them exactly*.

::: {.punchline}
Now the AI [sees]{.accent} like the best human in the room.
:::

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](../../images/work/377A0891.jpg)
:::
:::

---

## Could You Control [50 Drones]{.accent} at Once? {background-color="#252525"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.hook}
Disaster strikes. [One person]{.accent}. 50 drones. No room for error.
:::

What happens to your **brain** under that pressure?

We track brain signals *in real time* to find out — and build AI that steps in **before you hit your limit**.

::: {.punchline}
Because in a rescue mission, [hesitation]{.accent} *costs lives*.
:::

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](../../images/work/377A0919.jpeg)
:::
:::

---

## Could You Control a Robot on the [Moon]{.accent}? {background-color="#252525"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.hook}
Your signal takes [1.3 seconds]{.accent} to reach the Moon.
:::

That's **1.3 seconds** your robot is *completely on its own*.

We build robots smart enough to **survive that gap** — and study how humans stay in control when the stakes are *this high*.

::: {.punchline}
You on Earth. Robot on the Moon. [One team.]{.accent}
:::

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](../../images/work/377A0920.jpeg)
:::
:::
